name: es30-instancing
title: Instancing, divisors, primitive restart
summary: glDrawArraysInstanced / glDrawElementsInstanced with per-instance attributes (divisors 0, 1, 2, 3) and gl_InstanceID, instanced vs non-instanced draws, gl_PointSize per instance, glDrawRangeElements and PRIMITIVE_RESTART_FIXED_INDEX for UBYTE/USHORT/UINT indices, MAX_ELEMENT_INDEX: every instance position and every strip gap is probed against a CPU model.
spec: ES 3.0 §2.9.3 Drawing Commands (DrawArraysInstanced, DrawElementsInstanced, DrawRangeElements, MAX_ELEMENT_INDEX, MAX_ELEMENTS_VERTICES/INDICES)
ES 3.0 §2.11 Vertex Array Objects, Tables 6.2 and 6.3 (divisor is VAO state, the restart flag is not)
ES 3.0 §2.5 GL Errors, §6.1.2 Data Conversions, Table 6.28 (MAX_ELEMENT_INDEX)
GLSL ES 3.00 §7.1 Vertex Shader Special Variables (gl_VertexID, gl_InstanceID, gl_Position, gl_PointSize)

api.glGenVertexArrays: four VAOs with different divisor sets, a strip VAO and an empty VAO drive the validated draws
api.glBindVertexArray: VAO switching selects divisors and element buffer: divisor 1/2/3/0 cells match their models; ARRAY_DIVISOR read back per VAO
api.glDeleteVertexArrays: scratch VAO deleted; cleanup, final glGetError == NO_ERROR
api.glEnableVertexAttribArray: instanced attribute arrays 0/1/2 and strip arrays are sourced from buffers
api.glVertexAttribPointer: float vec2/vec3 and normalized UNSIGNED_BYTE vec3 attributes (stride 12) observed through pixels
api.glVertexAttribDivisor: divisor 0, 1, 2 and 3 on the offset/color attributes: each instance reads element floor(i / divisor); VERTEX_ATTRIB_ARRAY_DIVISOR read back (also 7 on a scratch VAO, 0 on a fresh VAO); index = MAX_VERTEX_ATTRIBS -> INVALID_VALUE
api.glGetVertexAttribiv: VERTEX_ATTRIB_ARRAY_DIVISOR of attributes 0/1/2 in four VAOs
api.glDrawArraysInstanced: TRIANGLE_STRIP x16, x5, and POINTS x4: every instance position/color and the empty remaining slots match the CPU model; instanceCount 0 draws nothing and raises no error; negative instanceCount / count -> INVALID_VALUE
api.glDrawElementsInstanced: TRIANGLES x16 with divisor-2 colors and TRIANGLE_STRIP x3 with primitive restart match the model; instanceCount 0 draws nothing; negative instanceCount -> INVALID_VALUE; type FLOAT -> INVALID_ENUM
api.glDrawRangeElements: [0,11] with a restart index in the list, [6,11] from byte offset 14, and a call exceeding MAX_ELEMENTS_VERTICES and MAX_ELEMENTS_INDICES all match the model; end < start -> INVALID_VALUE; type INT -> INVALID_ENUM
api.glDrawArrays: non-instanced draw with a divisor-1 VAO shows instance 0 only; gl_InstanceID reads 0
api.glDrawElements: TRIANGLE_STRIP with UNSIGNED_SHORT, UNSIGNED_BYTE and UNSIGNED_INT indices: gaps at the restart index (and the spike when restart is disabled) match the model
api.glEnable: PRIMITIVE_RESTART_FIXED_INDEX: strips split at 0xFF / 0xFFFF / 0xFFFFFFFF; glIsEnabled and glGetBooleanv report TRUE
api.glDisable: PRIMITIVE_RESTART_FIXED_INDEX: index 0xFF becomes vertex 255 (spike); glIsEnabled FALSE
api.glIsEnabled: PRIMITIVE_RESTART_FIXED_INDEX initially FALSE, TRUE after glEnable, FALSE after glDisable, not VAO state
api.glGetIntegerv: MAX_ELEMENT_INDEX clamped to INT_MAX, MAX_ELEMENTS_VERTICES, MAX_ELEMENTS_INDICES (used to size an exceeding draw), ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER_BINDING per VAO, MAX_VERTEX_ATTRIBS
api.glGetFloatv: ALIASED_POINT_SIZE_RANGE decides which point sizes are compared
api.glGenBuffers: vertex, offset, color, ribbon and index buffers feed the validated draws
api.glBindBuffer: ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER re-pointed per strip draw (VAO state); ARRAY_BUFFER captured by the attribute pointers
api.glBufferData: data observed through the rendered pixels (including a 3004-vertex buffer)
api.glUseProgram: four programs select the cell types
api.glGetUniformLocation: uniforms of all four programs located; effects observed in the pixels
api.glUniform1f: u_size, u_step, u_size0, u_dsize, u_fade: instance geometry and fading match the model
api.glUniform1i: u_columns: 4 slots per row in the gl_InstanceID shader
api.glUniform2f: u_origin, u_scale, u_step, u_cell: strip placement, instance stacking and point positions match the model
api.glViewport: per-cell viewports map NDC to the probed pixels
api.glClearColor: background pixels equal the clear color

visual_review.notes: Viewed gpu/llvmpipe/zink captures (256x256; identical within 1/255): row 3 shows four 4x4 quad grids (16 distinct colors; horizontal color pairs for divisor 2; groups of three for divisor 3; growing squares colored by gl_InstanceID bits); row 2 the twisted sliver of divisor 0, one quad plus a small dark-blue square (non-instanced draw), five quads (instanceCount 5) and four points of growing size 3/5/7/9; row 1 four ribbon strips: continuous with glue triangles, then two gapped (USHORT, UBYTE) and one with a white spike toward vertex 255 (restart disabled); row 0 the UINT gapped strip, three faded stacked gapped strips, the range-elements strip with its gap and the second ribbon alone. Background is the dark-blue clear color; no stray marks. Re-viewed 2026-11-11 after the window-size fix (gpu 1000x200 and 200x1000): the 16 cells form an 8x2 and a 2x8 grid in reading order with near-square cells; the same quad grids, ribbons, spike and point squares as at 256x256.
